A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same multiagent finetuning work. The main text, Appendices A–H, equations, 13 figures, and seven tables are readable and can be matched across the versions despite repagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original language-model experiments, including benchmark accuracies in Table 1, component ablations in Table 2, and additional diversity, MMLU, and transfer evaluations in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental outcomes in the main text and appendices. Their retention from v1 does not change their status as results produced by this work.

M1.justification: The generation and critic agents, majority-vote data selection, summarization, iterative finetuning, and debate inference remain unchanged in Section 2 and Algorithms 1–2. Appendix B.3 revises training settings and documentation without establishing a new algorithmic component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate arithmetic, GSM, and MATH. Appendix H already includes all five MATH difficulty levels, MMLU, and transfer from MATH or arithmetic to GSM in v1; these are retained in v2.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments. This includes Base, Majority, Debate, STaR where reported, Majority FT, and the single-agent, temperature, cooperative, and unique-ID comparisons.

E3.justification: Appendix B.3 changes Mistral training from two epochs to one, generation/critic learning rates from 2e-6/1e-6 to 5e-7/5e-7, and the learning rate across multiple finetuning iterations from 1e-6 to 5e-7. These are limited revisions to explicitly stated settings; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Table 2 retains the same component ablations. Appendices C–F retain the same diversity measurements, cooperative finetuning analysis, temperature and unique-ID comparisons, and five-agent experiment, with unchanged findings.

E5.justification: Accuracy with standard error and the plotted uncertainty displays are retained. Neither version changes repeated-run or seed reporting, uncertainty estimation procedures, or significance-testing protocols.

E6.justification: Tables 1–7 and the empirical figures retain their numerical results and trends. For example, Mistral's Table 1 MATH accuracy remains 22.50 ± 1.87, and Table 7 reports 68.80 ± 2.07 for the proposed method on MMLU in both versions. The revised Mistral training description is not accompanied by revised results.

T1.justification: The critic-dataset construction in Equation 1, diversity definitions in Appendix C, and specialization model and derivation in Appendix G, Equations 2–4, are unchanged. Their altered page placement does not introduce mathematical revisions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about role specialization, response diversity, sustained iterative self-improvement, and zero-shot generalization. No core contribution or claim scope is added or strengthened.

C2.justification: Interpretations of diversity, component benefits, generalization, and additional agents remain unchanged. Section 6 retains the same computational-cost limitations and suggested mitigations through weight sharing, distillation, or quantization.

D1.justification: Appendix B.3 newly specifies weight decay of 1e-2 for Mistral and for LLaMA-3 across multiple finetuning iterations, alongside the revised Mistral epochs and learning rates. This adds reproducibility information without establishing that weight decay was newly introduced. Hardware, model identifiers, batch sizes, and project-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5 and the cited works are unchanged. Changed bibliography back-reference page numbers reflect repagination, rather than added literature or revised research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds an acknowledgments section, replaces the Preprint header with an ICLR 2025 publication header, and updates Igor Mordatch's affiliation and email. Apart from the limited Appendix B.3 edits, the scientific narrative and section order remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The figures and tables retain their designs, captions, and contents. Acknowledgments and appendix reflow change placement and spacing; for example, Figures 12 and 13 share the final page in v2, whereas they occupy separate pages in v1. No figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: The previously omitted weight-decay settings in Appendix B.3 make the training description modestly more complete. The revised Mistral epochs and learning rates are not accompanied by changed results or an explanation of whether experiments were rerun. The benefit is therefore limited to reproducibility documentation; the scientific evidence, conclusions, and limitations remain unchanged.
